# The Art of Sensuality (TAOS)

> Tantra Massage, Workshops and Intimacy Coaching with TAOS, based in Stroud, Gloucestershire, UK, with workshops held across the UK.

TAOS is about stripping away conditioning, dissolving shame, and rediscovering the richness of sensuality as a path to deeper connection — with yourself, with others, and with life itself. It offers three distinct paths — massage, training, and coaching — each held in a safe, professional space to rediscover presence, intimacy, and your deeper self. TAOS was founded by Wesley Tan (BOst BSc), who practised as a registered osteopath from 2007 to 2020 and has taught movement and bodywork since 1999, beginning with kung fu and qi gong, then gymnastic fitness.

## Offerings

- [Our Offerings](https://theartofsensuality.com/offerings): Three distinct paths — massage, training, and coaching — each designed to invite you deeper into connection, pleasure, and authentic presence.
- [Tantra Massage](https://theartofsensuality.com/offerings/tantra): Professional Tantra Massage in Stroud — a deeply nourishing full-body journey that reconnects you with sensuality, presence, and self-awareness. Private sessions for singles and couples.
- [Intimacy Coaching](https://theartofsensuality.com/offerings/coaching): A guided, body-based approach to connection, sensual awareness, and conscious communication for individuals and couples, in Stroud and across the UK.
- [Tantra Massage Training & Workshops](https://theartofsensuality.com/offerings/workshops): Learn the complete Tantra Massage ritual on a 4-day foundation training for singles and couples. TAOS certificate, printed step-by-step manual, and a path to professional practice.
- [Couples Tantra Massage Training](https://theartofsensuality.com/offerings/couples-tantra-massage-training): Learn the complete Tantra Massage ritual together, taught privately to just the two of you. 15 hours of personal teaching with Wesley Tan BOst BSc in Stroud, Gloucestershire.

## Retreats

- [Tantra Massage Seminar, Powys 2027](https://theartofsensuality.com/retreats/powys-2027): A four-day residential retreat at Garth Barns & Country House, Powys, Wales (11–14 February 2027) to learn the full Tantra massage ritual, with consent, presence and breath at its heart.

- [Vulnerability & Connection — Are They the Same Thing?](https://theartofsensuality.com/blog/vulnerability-and-connection-are-they-the-same-thing): Are vulnerability and connection really opposites, or descriptions of the same thing?
